description: This file defines the MigrationLookup class, a Drupal plugin for migration processes that performs property value lookups based on previous migration mappings, including stub creation and handling missing relationships.

classes.name: MigrationLookup
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that performs property value lookups during migration, managing relationships, stub creation, and handling missing data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the migration plugin with configuration, migration, lookup, and stub services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin with dependency injection.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Performs the lookup or stub creation based on migration mappings, handling various edge cases and exceptions.

methods.name: skipInvalid
methods.description: Checks if the input value is invalid (null, false, empty array, or empty string) and stops the pipeline if so.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Determines if a value is valid for lookup, returning false for null, false, empty array, or empty string.
